thread:
emma: deploy-bot blocked GA for rc12 -> SBOM mismatch: amd64 image has SBOM, arm64 image missing SBOM entry. tagging infra + security.
deploy-bot: alert: artifact rc12 multi-arch validation failed -> missing SBOM for architecture: arm64. Policy: all published artifacts must have SBOMs for each arch. See /artifacts/rc12.
ryan: build pipeline shows arm64 stage failed to upload sbom.json due to timeout. image pushed, but sbom upload errored.
megan: vuln-scan across amd64 looks clean. Security: is it acceptable to publish amd64 while we fix arm64? any exploitability differences?
sec-bot: triage: arm64 vs amd64 parity matters for on-prem and edge customers using arm. Risk: without arm SBOM we can't attest provenance; policy requires per-arch SBOM for GA. Recommendation: allow scoped GA for amd64-hosted only (non-arm regions) with approval exception logged; pause arm64 and on-prem until SBOM attached.
emma: can we do a temporary carveout: publish amd64 to hosted API and dedicated pools that are x86 only, timeboxed 4h, while we re-run sbom upload for arm64? We'll attach upload logs and CI ticket.
ryan: re-run sbom upload job should be ~25m fix + 10m upload. I can queue it now.
megan: CS: we have an enterprise ARM customer scheduled tomorrow — must notify and pause their rollout.
emma: propose path: (1) file approval AP-1769999990 for amd64 scoped GA (non-arm), (2) schedule arm64 rebuild and sbom upload within 2h, (3) auto-unpublish amd64 if SBOM not attached within 4h, (4) notify arm customers.
sec-bot: conditional sign-off if: approval ticket updated, sbom upload logs posted within 2h, and deploy-bot enforces timebox and scope.
deploy-bot: scoped publish command: ```/publish --image redwood/inference:rc12 --arch amd64 --scope hosted-x86 --timebox 4h --rollback_on=error>0.75%``` will enforce scope and auto-unpublish.
ryan: sbom upload job started. CI job id: ci/rc12/sbom-upload-778. ETA ~30m. Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/ci/rc12/sbom-upload-778/logs
megan: notifying CS and pausing arm customer rollouts. message: "RC12: arm64 artifact SBOM missing; x86 hosted rollout proceeding with mitigation; on-prem/arm paused pending SBOM evidence."
emma: uploading approval AP-1769999990 with mitigation notes and link to CI job.
ryan: sbom upload completed and attached: https://artifacts.redwood/sboms/rc12/arm64-sbom.json. verification: pass.
sec-bot: SBOM verification OK for arm64. removing pause. GA publish allowed for all arches.
deploy-bot: verification passed. full GA publish may proceed.
emma: thanks everyone  will update release notes: "RC12: temporary x86 scoped carveout due to arm64 SBOM upload failure; resolved and full GA resumed." closing thread. :white_check_mark:
